name: snake-battle-royale
description: Real-time Multiplayer Snake Battle Royale Game (Spec-Driven Development + Graph Engineering)

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run spec:validate
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check server && uv run ruff format --check server && uv run ty check server
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix server && uv run ruff format server
scripts.android:sync-client: cd client && npm run build && mkdir -p ../android/app/src/main/assets/client_dist && cp -r dist/* ../android/app/src/main/assets/client_dist/
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync-client && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

author: Snake Royale Team
